rule_description: Windows Multiple Failed Logins Detected (Brute Force Attack Pattern).
recommended_actions: [CONTAINMENT] Apply host isolation to Endpoint 'DESKTOP-BJ2IO2A' (ID 001) via Wazuh Active Response.
[IDENTITY] Temporarily lock account 'Administrator' and revoke active Kerberos/NTLM tickets.
[NETWORK] Block or rate-limit source address '192.168.31.105' at edge firewall.
[FORENSICS] Export Security.evtx from endpoint and audit for any subsequent successful logons (Event ID 4624).
[INVESTIGATION] Triage active network sockets (netstat -ano) and parent process trees for unauthorized tooling.
[REMEDIATION] Require immediate password rotation and enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).
